title: Irish Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting beef stew inspired by Irish cuisine, with tender brisket and vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: Brown the brisket in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Remove the browned brisket from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, browned brisket, salt, and black pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the brisket is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the flour to thicken the stew.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
